messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Unusual TPM spike for model-family 'strait12b' (us-west, eu-west). 3x baseline requests, latency p50->p95 shift, ERROR rate +4.5%

maria: I'm on it. grabbing telemetry now. Paging @sam @taylor if you can join.

sam: Oncall here. Any customer-facing errors or just latency?

maria: frontend traces show increased user timeouts and a few 500s from runtime. Some clients hit rate-limit callbacks. Possible hot-tenant.

sam: Looking at routing: big chunk from tenant 'acme-marketing' hitting strait12b proxy pool. 65% of extra traffic from 1 API key.

maria: Good find. Can we temporarily throttle per-key TPM for that key and lower pool TPM for strait12b? Need quick mitigation to protect other tenants.

sam: I'll apply a per-key soft cap first. Command: 
```bash
# soft-limit acme-marketing to 1200 TPM
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas" -d '{"key":"acme-marketing","model_family":"strait12b","tpm":1200,"mode":"soft"}'
```
Applying now.

ops-bot: quota-update: acknowledged. Key acme-marketing -> 1200 TPM (soft). Change ID: q_9b3f

maria: Nice. Meanwhile, suggestion: reduce pool TPM for strait12b from 6000 -> 1800 to shed burst and keep p95 stable. That will affect a few background jobs but prevents broader SLO violations. @taylor can you approve/push?

taylor: Approve. Push throttling plan. I will also disable heavy function-calls for strait12b to reduce KV/cache pressure.

alex: FYI customer success: I'm pinging the support lead for acme to check if they deployed something. Copying account team.

ops-bot: model-pool-update: strait12b global TPM cap set to 1800. Change ID: pool_22c4.

sam: Metrics: within 30s p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 720ms, error rate down to 0.8%. Throughput stabilized.

maria: Good. Logging decisions and timeline in incident ticket INC-2026-317.

sam: Also toggled funcall for strait12b off: 
```json
{"model_family":"strait12b","feature_toggle":"funcall","state":"disabled","reason":"mitigation: reduce heavy ops"}
```

ops-bot: feature-toggle: funcall disabled for strait12b. Toggle ID: ft_7a1d

taylor: Handing off to next oncall for follow-up at 04:00 UTC — please monitor replays and tenant backoff. I'll stay reachable for 15m.

maria: Account update: acme confirmed a misconfigured client loop, rolling a fix. They requested temporary increased soft limit once they patch.

sam: Plan: keep pool cap 1800 + key soft cap for 30m, then evaluate. If acme patched, remove soft cap and gradually raise pool TPM in steps (1800 -> 3000 -> 4500) with 5m observation.

alex: Noting customer impact: short user-facing errors for some orgs ~10-12 minutes, then degraded latency for ~25m. Communicating to CS.

ops-bot: incident-note: mitigation applied (per-key soft cap + pool cap + funcall disabled).

maria: Recovered baseline traffic pattern now. Leaving incident open for follow-up and postmortem. Thanks all :white_check_mark:

taylor: I'll draft postmortem action items: add automated hot-tenant detection + optional per-key auto-cap.

sam: Closing actions: revert funcall only after verifying p95 stable for 30m, confirm acme fix, and verify no other tenants affected.

maria: last check-in: all good. closing thread in 1h if no regression.

incident-bot: Incident update logged at 5312345890.
